title: Research: wolfHSM backend thread safety of shared client context
description: wp11_wolfhsm_key_priv_t holds a borrowed pointer to the slot's whClientContext. Multiple concurrent C_Sign/C_Verify/C_Decrypt calls on the same slot will call wh_Client_EccSign, wh_Client_RsaFunction, etc., on the same context simultaneously with no mutex. Whether this is safe depends on whether wolfHSM's client context is thread-safe internally. Research: (1) Check wolfHSM client source for thread safety guarantees. (2) If not thread-safe, the fix is to hold g_lock across the full backend call (currently g_lock is released before the backend call in some paths) or add a per-slot mutex. (3) Document the finding either way.
